knowledge:
- key_parameters: databaseFile=Path to the SQL database containing the genomes (created via DECIPHER) ;; central_ID=Identifier for the central genome of interest in the database ;; related_IDs=Identifiers for the related genomes in the database used for evolutionary conservation ;; useProt=Logical indicating whether to use proteomics data (set to FALSE if no proteomics data is provided) ;; protHits_Seqs=Vector of peptide sequences for proteomics hits ;; protHits_Scores=Vector of confidence scores for the proteomics hits ;; geneLeftPos=Vector of left boundary positions of the genes (in forward strand terms, 1-based) ;; geneRightPos=Vector of right boundary positions of the genes (in forward strand terms, 1-based) ;; geneStrand=Vector of strand information ("+" or "-") ;; inputMapObj=The mapping object of class Assessment and subclass DataMap returned by MapAssessmentData ;; geneSource=Character string naming the source of the gene predictions (e.g., "Prodigal") ;; interactive_GV=Logical indicating whether the genome viewer plot should be interactive
- alternatives: AssessORFData=A companion data package providing pre-saved mapping and results objects for 20 strains, which can be used instead of building mapping objects from scratch if the target strain is included.
- when_to_use: Use when you have a newly sequenced or annotated prokaryotic genome and want to evaluate the accuracy of its predicted gene boundaries (especially start sites) using evolutionary conservation across related strains and/or proteomics data.
- pitfalls: The package is only intended to be used with prokaryotes (viruses are only used in examples for speed). Strand information must be exactly "+" or "-". Left and right boundary positions must always be in forward strand terms (5' to 3' of the forward strand), meaning for reverse strand genes, the left boundary is the stop and the right boundary is the start. Position one of a gene must correspond to the first nucleotide of the gene, not the zero-th nucleotide (1-based indexing). The same genome sequence must be used to generate both the mapping object and the set of genes to assess. Building a mapping object is a long process, but it is independent of gene boundaries, so it should be saved and reused when comparing multiple gene prediction sets.

workflows.name: assess_orf_predictions
workflows.intent: Map evolutionary conservation and/or proteomics evidence to a central genome and assess the quality of predicted gene boundaries.
input: databaseFile (SQLite database containing central and related genomes, populated using DECIPHER)
geneLeftPos, geneRightPos, geneStrand (vectors of gene coordinates from a prediction tool like Prodigal)
workflows.stages:
1. Map evolutionary conservation and/or proteomics data to the central genome using MapAssessmentData.
2. Parse gene prediction coordinates (left, right, strand).
3. Assess the predicted genes against the mapped evidence using AssessGenes.
4. Visualize the results using print, plot, mosaicplot, or the genome viewer.
5. Optionally compare results from different prediction programs using CompareAssessmentResults.
workflows.code:
library(DECIPHER)

databaseFile <- tempfile()

relGenomesFile <- system.file("extdata",
                           "AdenoviridaeGenomes.csv",
                           package = "AssessORF")

genomesTable <- read.csv(relGenomesFile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[1:13, ]
ftps <- genomesTable$GenBank.FTP
ftps <- paste(ftps, paste0(basename(ftps), "_genomic.fna.gz"), sep="/")
ftps <- ftps[(substring(ftps, 1, 6) == "ftp://")]

pass <- logical(length(ftps))

identifiers <- as.character(which(pass))

library(AssessORF)

myMapObj <- MapAssessmentData(databaseFile,
                              central_ID = identifiers[1],
                              related_IDs = identifiers[-1],
                              speciesName = "Human adenovirus 1",
                              useProt = FALSE)

unlink(databaseFile)

currMapObj <- readRDS(system.file("extdata",
                                  "MGAS5005_PreSaved_DataMapObj.rds",
                                  package = "AssessORF"))

currProdigal <- readLines(system.file("extdata",
                                      "MGAS5005_Prodigal.sco",
                                      package = "AssessORF"))[-1:-2]

prodigalLeft <- as.numeric(sapply(strsplit(currProdigal, "_", fixed=TRUE), `[`, 2L))
prodigalRight <- as.numeric(sapply(strsplit(currProdigal, "_", fixed=TRUE), `[`, 3L))
prodigalStrand <- sapply(strsplit(currProdigal, "_", fixed=TRUE), `[`, 4L)

currResObj <- AssessGenes(geneLeftPos = prodigalLeft,
                          geneRightPos = prodigalRight,
                          geneStrand = prodigalStrand,
                          inputMapObj = currMapObj,
                          geneSource = "Prodigal")

print(currResObj)

plot(currResObj)

plot(currMapObj, currResObj, interactive_GV = FALSE,
     rangeStart_GV = 106000, rangeEnd_GV = 120000)

mosaicplot(currResObj)

resObj2 <- readRDS(system.file("extdata",
                                  "MGAS5005_PreSaved_ResultsObj_GeneMarkS2.rds",
                                  package = "AssessORF"))

CompareAssessmentResults(currResObj, resObj2)
